prompt: Create an original 60 second gamelan-inspired instrumental instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: metallophones, soft gong, bamboo flute. Style: cyclic interlocking metallic patterns with long gong punctuation. Tempo approximately 72 BPM; D major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A gentle and melodic instrumental piece featuring a plucked string instrument (like a zither or harp) playing a repeating arpeggiated pattern, accompanied by a soft, sustained wind instrument (flute or recorder) carrying the main melody. The music evokes a calm and peaceful atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首轻柔而旋律优美的纯音乐作品，以拨弦乐器（如扬琴或竖琴）演奏重复的琶音模式为主，并伴有柔和、持续的管乐器（长笛或竖笛）演奏主旋律。音乐营造出平静祥和的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
